newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian ruler supports OAU conference on Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian ruler supports OAU conference on Zaire.

text.p: Nigerian military ruler General Sani Abacha has welcomed a special session of the Organisation of African Unity in Lome, Togo, next week on the Zaire conflict, presidency officials said on Friday.
They said Abacha expressed his support on Thursday when he received Togolese Foreign Minister Pierre Koffi Panou in the capital Abuja.
"The head of state was emphatic that the Lome talks are essential to try to resolve the Zaire crisis in an African way," said one official.
Panou was in Abuja to brief Abacha on the Lome meeting.
Nigerian officials said Abacha believed that the Lome talks would bring the parties to the dispute to negotiations.
"The OAU conflict resolution mechanism ought to be exploited to find purely African solutions to our peculiar problems," one said.
An envoy of Zaire's ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko met Abacha in Abuja in November and gave him a detailed account of the conflict, Nigeria officials said at the time.
